findings.evidence: Conclusion is `K.toDisKinematics.xBj g = xi g K * beta g K` (line 104). Repo precedent: `Kinematics/Bounds.lean:40 lemma xBj_pos`, `:46 lemma xBj_le_one`, `Tensors/Longitudinal.lean:260 lemma two_xBj_mul_pq`, `pq_ne_zero_of_xBj_ne_zero`. This is the only `x_`-prefixed lemma in `EpsilonEridani/`. Naming conventions: "_-separated strings in a lemma name correspond to a definition name or connective" (namespace removed, i.e. `xBj`).
findings.issue: `x_eq_xi_mul_beta` names the concluded left-hand side `x`, but the declaration it is about is `DisKinematics.xBj`; `x` corresponds to no definition in the repo, and every other lemma about this quantity uses `xBj`.

findings.evidence: `Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:52 def Q2 (g : Bilin V) (K : ExclKinematics V)`, `:68 def tMom`, `:76 noncomputable def xiSkew`, `:80 def phiDiff` are all in `namespace ExclKinematics` and used as `K.tMom g`, `K.xiSkew g` (`:151`, `:153`); the new declarations take the same record but sit in `namespace Diffractive` (Diffractive/Basic.lean:51, 73-85).
findings.fix: Declare them in the record's namespace from this file (`namespace Exclusive.Kinematics.ExclKinematics` — no file move needed) under disambiguating names mirroring `xiSkew`, e.g. `xiDiff`, `betaDiff`, `MX2`, and update `x_eq_xi_mul_beta` accordingly.
findings.issue: `xi`, `beta` (line 79) and `MX2` (line 85) are invariants whose principal argument is `ExclKinematics V`, but they are declared in `DIS.Diffractive` rather than the `ExclKinematics` namespace, so `K.xi g` / `K.beta g` / `K.MX2 g` do not elaborate while every other invariant of that same record does. The bare names `xi`/`beta` also give no cue against the existing, numerically different `ExclKinematics.xiSkew` on the same record.

summary: The key theorem is named `x_eq_xi_mul_beta` although the quantity it concludes about is `DisKinematics.xBj`, against the repo-wide `xBj` lemma-name convention; and the three new invariants of `ExclKinematics` sit outside that record's namespace, so `K.xi g` does not elaborate while every sibling invariant (`K.Q2 g`, `K.tMom g`, `K.xiSkew g`) does.
